skills.name: 21st-cli-use
skills.description: Search, install and pull code from the 21st.dev catalog (components, themes, templates), from the terminal via the @21st-dev/cli.

skills.name: 21st-ai
skills.description: Generate and iterate on UI with 21st AI from the terminal: sketch variants from a prompt, edit any variant in place with a natural-language change, and pull the code into your project (`21st generate` / `generation` / `iterate` / `take`).

skills.name: 21st-registry
skills.description: Publish your own React components, themes and templates to 21st.dev, edit/unpublish/delete them, and manage your public profile page (bento board), via the unified @21st-dev/cli.

skills.name: 21st-design-sync
skills.description: Read the current project's shadcn/Tailwind design tokens and publish them to the 21st.dev community as a shareable theme via `21st publish-theme`.

skills.name: 21st-ui-build
skills.description: Build or change production UI using the project's own design context, existing components and grounded 21st inspiration.

skills.name: 21st-ui-explore
skills.description: Explore several meaningfully different UI directions, grounded in the project's design system, when the visual direction is still open.

skills.name: 21st-ui-review
skills.description: Review UI against the project's design context, accessibility, responsive behavior and interaction quality, with safe mechanical fixes.
